summary.name: Putting Together Great SRE Teams
summary.one_liner: A SREcon16 conference talk by Kripa Krishnan (Google) on what mix of people and specialist roles makes up a great site reliability engineering team.
keywords: how to staff an sre team
use_cases: Understanding what roles belong on an SRE team
Deciding whether SRE is only software or systems engineers
Making use of specialist and diverse skills in an SRE organization
Reading background material on SRE team culture
summary.what_it_does: ["This is a conference talk page from USENIX SREcon16, not a software tool. The talk asks what kinds of people make up a great SRE team and whether SRE means only software or systems engineers. It discusses the value that other roles bring to a team. It also covers how to make full use of specialist roles and diverse skills in an SRE organization. The speaker is Kripa Krishnan, a Technical Program Director at Google who has led Google's Disaster Recovery Program (DiRT). The page gives no slides, video, or detailed takeaways beyond the abstract."]
notable: Speaker leads Google's Disaster Recovery Program (DiRT) and heads the Google Cloud Product Operations Group
Part of USENIX SREcon16 (Santa Clara, April 2016)
Covers non-engineering and specialist roles within SRE teams
caveats: Page is only a talk abstract and speaker bio; no slides, video, or transcript are included in the text
SREcon16 was sold out, so the event itself is no longer open for registration
